subject.title: fix(chat): keep proof decision out of actor closure

question: Does the chat/outbox owner accept holding the proof hub lock from the final SQLite decision through cancellation-marker update and outbox-change emission in `cancelCommand`?
rationale: Source and tests support the narrow actor-isolation fix, but automated checks cannot prove the intended cancellation-versus-canonical-proof synchronization boundary for message delivery.

options.title: Accept current lock boundary
options.body: Confirm the current lock region is the intended race boundary, then merge after normal exact-head checks are settled.

options.title: Narrow the lock after SQLite decision
options.body: Ask for a small patch that unlocks immediately after the SQLite decision if marker update and outbox emission should remain outside the proof lock.

recommendation.title: Accept current lock boundary
recommendation.body: Confirm the current lock region is the intended race boundary, then merge after normal exact-head checks are settled.
